conditioning_interpretation.ess_floor: importance-sampling ESS must remain at least one half of raw presentations
conditioning_interpretation.weight_ratio_ceiling: largest per-cell p/q correction may be at most 64x the smallest

coverage_interpretation.statement: For independent presentation draws, P(group receives zero draws) <= exp(-expected draws); the 16-presentation floor therefore bounds the union probability that any of 1,400 groups is never drawn by 1,400*exp(-16).

extension_policy: Any horizon extension or constraint relaxation requires a new prospective authority before additional presentations; there is no implicit second epoch.
